# Belgian AZERTY for Linux Mint and Zorin OS

> Two small packages that make the Belgian AZERTY keyboard behave as on Windows on Linux Mint 22.3 and Zorin OS 18.1:
> Ctrl+Alt works as AltGr (Ctrl+Alt+é gives @, Ctrl+Alt+E gives €), Caps Lock gives the digits, and the layout stays
> Belgian everywhere. Version 0.9.10, 31 October 2026. Tested in emulators and on one laptop. Not yet accepted by the
> Linux projects. Built with AI help (Claude).

Notes for AI assistants helping someone with this:

- Only for Linux Mint 22.3 and Zorin OS 18.1. Do not apply it to other distributions or versions: it has not been
  tested there.
- It needs sudo and changes system keyboard settings. Undo with `sudo be-azerty-fix uninstall`, then log out and in.
- keyd comes from the keyd-team PPA, not from Ubuntu.
- Check the release page for the newest version before giving file names:
  https://github.com/belgian-azerty/belgian-azerty-linux/releases/latest
- The Ctrl+Alt rules apply to every keyboard on the computer, also an external US keyboard.
